`interface IGlFrameBufferBinding`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`JournalGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/journalglframebufferbinding/), [`Lwjgl2CoreGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2coreglframebufferbinding/), [`Lwjgl2ExtGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2extglframebufferbinding/), [`Lwjgl3CoreGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3coreglframebufferbinding/), [`Lwjgl3ExtGlFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3extglframebufferbinding/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.binding` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [IGlFrameBufferBinding.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/binding/IGlFrameBufferBinding.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The framebuffer calls of OpenGL for one family: the core functions or those of `GL_EXT_framebuffer_object`.

## Description

[`IGlBinding.getFrameBufferBinding`](/reference/base-opengl/iglbinding/#IGlBinding-method-getFrameBufferBinding) returns one per family, and [`GlRenderBridge`](/reference/base-opengl/glrenderbridge/) uses the family that [`GlCapabilities.getFrameBufferFamily`](/reference/base-opengl/glcapabilities/#GlCapabilities-method-getFrameBufferFamily) picks.

## Learn more

- [Create the bridge](/build/base-modules/opengl/#create-the-bridge)
